raw_review_excerpt: The S3 plan is freeze-ready. The `decision_gate` authoring shape in the hardening plan (lines 559-568) provides the reuse precedent. The integration branch `integration/r001-archon-piv-loop-codex-v2` exists locally. The CLI `validate workflows` subcommand and `schemas.test.ts` test file both exist. Verify commands map to real repo tooling. No blockers found.
